PSW Atlas

246 lectures · 2086 concepts · fields are territories — drag to pan, scroll to zoom, click a node

An independent side project mapping the public lecture archive of PSW Science (the Philosophical Society of Washington, founded 1871). Every lecture links to the society's own recording on their YouTube channel. Concepts and one-line summaries are machine-generated from the public pages and captions, and may contain errors — the recordings are the record. Built by John Santerre, a member of the society.
